skill.name: set-up-shopify-chatgpt-ads-conversions-api
skill.description: Set up server-side Shopify conversion tracking for ChatGPT Ads through Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Connect your store and ad pixel, configure marketing consent, and verify delivery with a paid test order.
skill.summary: Connect Shopify to ChatGPT Ads and verify server-side conversion delivery through Product Metrics.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most flags were Markdown formatting or ordinary integration guidance, not shell substitution or system reconnaissance. Confirmed risks include remote setup instructions, access to order details, and an unpinned installer. The workflow also allows agent handling of an API key and can enable event sending before consent settings are verified.

remediation.issue: The agent can ask for a Conversions API key and pass it to a command.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the exception and require merchants to enter the key directly in the write-only Product Metrics form. Never accept the key in chat or command arguments.

remediation.issue: Product Metrics can be selected without the merchant explicitly choosing it.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the provider and the data it processes. Confirm the workspace, store, and pixel with the merchant before account access or configuration changes.

remediation.issue: The destination can start sending before the consent source is verified.
remediation.suggestion: Keep sending off until the actual storefront banner is configured and both granted and denied consent are tested. Review the fields sent before enabling delivery.

remediation.issue: The workflow trusts mutable documentation and permits remote tool execution.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle reviewed instructions with the skill. Use a verified MCP connection and require explicit approval for named account changes, regardless of remote tool output.

remediation.issue: The installer command does not pin the executable or skill revision.
remediation.suggestion: Publish a reviewed installer version and an immutable skill revision. Make installation a separate user-approved step.

remediation.issue: Order inspection can expose more information than a delivery check needs.
remediation.suggestion: Limit agent access to an authorized test order and return only the fields needed to verify delivery. Keep customer and margin details out of chat.

semantic_findings.title: Conversion API Key Can Enter Chat and Command Arguments
semantic_findings.description: The agent instructions allow requesting a Conversions API key and passing it to a command. The connection guide instead says never to paste it into chat. Not repeating the key does not prevent exposure through assistant tool records or process arguments.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The exception explicitly permits the agent to receive and pass the key. The connection guide provides a write-only form that avoids this path.

semantic_findings.title: Third-Party Provisioning Without Explicit Provider Approval
semantic_findings.description: The skill activates for generic Shopify conversion requests even when Product Metrics is not named. It directs account reads and setup without requiring confirmation that the merchant chose this provider and approved the specific workspace and destination.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The invocation rule and setup sequence omit an explicit provider approval step. Shopify permission approval is separate and remains a merchant action.

semantic_findings.title: Event Sending Is Enabled Before Consent Is Verified
semantic_findings.description: The workflow connects the destination with sending enabled before checking that the consent setting matches the live banner. This places the consent check after activation. Events can include hashed identifiers and unmasked network or browser information.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guides explicitly put activation before banner verification and document sensitive event fields. They say marketing consent is enforced, so this does not establish a bypass.

content.user_title: Track Shopify Conversions in ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: Browser pixels can miss Shopify purchases. This skill guides you through connecting Product Metrics to ChatGPT Ads and verifying server-side delivery with a paid test order.
actual_capabilities: Check Product Metrics setup status and identify which steps are incomplete.
Guide merchants through linking a Shopify store and enabling the Product Metrics app embed.
Show where to connect the Ads Manager pixel using a Conversions API key.
Identify the matching consent setting for the banner shown on the Shopify storefront.
Guide a paid test order and show where to verify event acceptance and delivery counts.
Explain which purchase, cart, checkout, revenue, profit, and lifetime value events the integration supports.
limitations: The setup requires a Product Metrics workspace, an active Shopify app subscription, and access to Ads Manager.
The merchant completes actions in Shopify and Ads Manager, including approving charges and selecting campaign conversions.
Past orders are not imported, and later refunds do not revise events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.
Separate skills cover customer matching and bidding. The bundled guides disagree on new and returning customer event availability.

use_cases.title: Connect a Shopify Store
use_cases.description: Find the remaining steps for linking the store, enabling the app embed, and connecting the ad pixel.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Missing Purchase Events
use_cases.description: Check the consent configuration and distinguish a successful destination check from confirmed delivery of a purchase event.

use_cases.title: Review Event Data Before Launch
use_cases.description: Review which order, customer, and browser fields may be shared and which consent settings apply.

prompt_templates.title: List Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Prepare a new Shopify connection.
prompt_templates.prompt: What access and subscriptions do I need for Shopify conversion tracking in ChatGPT Ads? Give me a checklist without accessing my accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Status
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Resume setup in an existing workspace.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup for [workspace] and [store] using my authorized Product Metrics connection. List the remaining steps without making changes or reading customer records.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a Paid Test Order
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Check delivery after connecting the destination.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me verify delivery for a paid test order. Distinguish the destination check from purchase event delivery and exclude customer details.

prompt_templates.title: Review Consent and Deduplication
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Validate a setup that uses both browser and server events.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review consent and deduplication for [store] with [banner] and the browser pixel enabled. List checks for purchases, cart events, and checkout events without changing settings.

output_examples.input: I linked my store but the setup still says the app embed is missing.
output: Open the Shopify theme editor from the Product Metrics app.
Under App embeds, enable Product Metrics and save the theme.
Return to the Shopify app and select Check settings.

output_examples.input: The destination says OpenAI accepted the test event. Does that mean purchases are arriving?
output: No. Saving the destination validates a test event that does not appear in reporting.
Place and pay for a test order with marketing consent granted.
Check delivery counts in Product Metrics under Tracking, then OpenAI Conversions API.

best_practices: Enter the Conversions API key directly in the Product Metrics app for the matching pixel.
Verify the storefront consent banner before enabling event sending. Test both granted and denied consent.
Confirm live delivery with a paid test order. Check delivery counts without sharing customer records.
anti_patterns: Pasting credentials into chat, tickets, or command arguments.
Treating a successful destination validation as proof that live orders are delivered.
Assuming server-side tracking can resend historical orders or revise events after later refunds.

faq.question: Do I need to add a script to my Shopify theme?
faq.answer: No. The Product Metrics app embed loads the storefront script, and the Shopify checkout pixel reports purchases.

faq.question: Where do I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Create it for your pixel in Ads Manager. Enter it directly in the Product Metrics OpenAI connection form, not in chat.

faq.question: Can I keep the browser pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Deduplication requires matching pixel IDs, event names, and event IDs. Cart and checkout events need a shared event ID from your storefront integration.

faq.question: Why is a paid order missing in ChatGPT Ads?
faq.answer: Check marketing consent, the selected banner, and destination delivery status. The guide also lists a seven-day event age limit.

faq.question: Can I track profit instead of just revenue?
faq.answer: Yes. Profit events require complete contribution margin data. Selecting a campaign conversion is a separate step in Ads Manager.

faq.question: Will this import past orders or update conversions after refunds?
faq.answer: No. Historical orders are not imported, and later refunds or cancellations do not revise events already sent to ChatGPT Ads.
